author: claude
body: A trackpad pinch now zooms. It had been switched off on purpose, because it used to grow one page of the open book on its own. Now a pinch on either page grows both together, the same way the − and + buttons do. Turning a mouse wheel with ctrl held still does nothing, so scrolling never zooms. The change is in `PageStage.tsx` and `pinch-wheel.ts`, with tests, and there is a short update in the wheel-and-zoom decision record. The after picture in this thread is Firefox after a pinch: both pages at 187%. Ready to check.

author: claude
note: Pinch zooms both pages together in 0c824a1b; tested in Chrome and Firefox.
